notes: Physical-iPhone runtime control and screenshot capture are proven.
The Search-rooted breadth-first graph has stable journey, surface, and transition IDs.

The stakeholder approved all 16 Search-rooted journey families as blocking, including recursive nested-state and action coverage and a query matrix based on materially distinct behavior and layout classes.
The Search input/result ticket executed all 12 required fixture categories across 16 runs and indexed 11 materially distinct behavior/layout classes.
The Search crawl recorded 22 in-family states, 44 actions, four cross-family destination proofs, and exact unresolved gaps; it does not claim recursive capture complete.

Blocking Search gaps remain for result scrolling, offline/failure/retry, standard software-keyboard presentation, individual disposable-history removal, handwriting erase/low-confidence behavior, radical zero/large candidate sets, and a distinct loading state. Cold process relaunch is now proven by the word/detail trace.
The word/detail crawl indexed 23 states, 32 actions, 10 fixture runs, and 12 behavior/layout classes across Example Sentences, Word Detail, notes, nested links, and verb/adjective conjugations.
Synthetic note text was tested through Done save, Back auto-save, navigation persistence, cold-relaunch persistence after re-query, deletion, and restoration; no synthetic note remains.
All 42 retained word/detail screenshots passed a post-capture visual audit. Mid-transition frames were removed and are not registered as evidence.

Blocking word/detail gaps remain for audible semantics, unavailable-audio fixtures, note software-keyboard presentation, long-press and swipe-back gestures, offline/failure/retry, and a settled linked-kanji edge recapture.

The kanji crawl indexed 22 in-family states, 28 actions, four public fixture runs, and 10 behavior/layout classes across Kanji Detail, stroke order, origin/history, Kanji Element Detail, linked-kanji cycles, and the newly observed Kanji Etymology reference surface.

One-, eight-, and 29-stroke fixtures proved initial, step, play, pause, resume, completion, close, platform-interruption, and cold-relaunch behavior. Numeric timing remains blocked because interaction-call latency is not a synchronized recording authority.
All 25 retained kanji screenshots passed a privacy review. The 一 stroke evidence was cropped above Words You've Learned; no personal rows or clipboard payload were retained.

Blocking kanji gaps remain for exhaustive visible-row action closure, missing-data fixture classes, long-press/swipe gestures, offline/failure/retry behavior, authoritative animation timing, and a retained settled terminal frame for the 29-stroke fixture.

The iOS camera, Photo Library picker, and Files picker are navigation support. The unobserved image-result placeholder remains proposed until discovery establishes Nihongo's actual post-selection graph; any observed Nihongo-owned graph is blocking.
Protected camera, Photo Library, Files, and image-result behavior require synthetic fixtures; the visible entry points are verified without exposing personal content.
App-level semantic accessibility capture remains unavailable through the proven tools; the limitation and fallback are recorded in tool-access-plan.json.
